name: Power Systems Laboratory
description: The lab provides practical exposure to power system analysis and equipment behavior. Experiments include measurement of sequence impedances of alternators and transformers, study of characteristics and coordination of overcurrent, directional, and differential relays, and load flow and fault analysis on multi-bus power systems. Students will also investigate transmission line limits, perform synchronization of alternators, and explore reactive power compensation using synchronous condensers.
